headline: Anthropic Shares Surge in Market Debut, Breaking Record: The 10 Biggest Stock Market Debuts in History
summary: The Claude developer debuted on the stock market on Thursday, raising $81.3 billion. The listing ranks among the biggest IPO debuts in history.
why: Anthropic is a San Francisco artificial intelligence developer. Large IPOs show how much capital investors are willing to commit to AI companies and can shape valuations across the sector.
why_moved: The listing drew strong investor demand and raised a very large sum in a single offering. Heavy IPO demand for a leading AI company can draw capital away from other technology shares.
original_headline: Anthropic sale a bolsa y rompe récord: Los 10 mayores debuts bursátiles de la historia
